exact=false should return approximate count faster
contract_grounding.note: Contract semantics violated: exact=false returns 64 vs exact:true=100, difference=36%

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: count_api.rs → do_count_points → local_shard.estimate_cardinality → segment.estimate_point_count → payload_index.estimate_cardinality → condition_cardinality → Condition::IsEmpty → estimate_field_condition → null_index.estimate_cardinality (hardcoded heuristic: exp = 2 * estimated / 3)
source_grounding.note: Source接地发现: null_index.estimate_cardinality 对 is_empty 条件使用硬编码启发式 'exp = 2 * estimated / 3'，假设1/3的点被删除。在无删除点的场景下(我们的测试数据)，这导致系统性36%低估(64 vs 100真值)。这是真缺陷，不是by-design。

contract.note: Contract violation: exact=false should approximate but not deviate by 36% from ground truth

behavioral.note: Source code shows hardcoded heuristic '2 * estimated / 3 assuming 1/3 deleted' - this is a bug, not graceful degradation. No by-design comment explaining this assumption.

verdicts.rationale: 通过源码接地(qdrant/v1.18.3/lib/segment/src/index/field_index/null_index/read_ops.rs:182)发现 null_index.estimate_cardinality 对 is_empty 条件使用硬编码启发式: exp = 2 * estimated / 3，假设1/3的点被删除。在无删除点的测试数据集(200点中100点有kw, 100点无kw)下，exact=true返回100(真值), exact=false返回64(错误, 36%低估)。scroll独立验证确认真值为100。这不是by-design，而是基数估算公式错误，属于 bug_shapes.json 中 cardinality_oracle 模式的实例。
